\item Four of the sixteen cells, \fvval{h2-lowstab-cells}, have a diagonal fraction (section~\ref{sec:data}) of only \fvval{h2-lowstab-min}--\fvval{h2-lowstab-max}.
\item The step-1 weight of truth events without a reconstructed partner comes from a regression fitted with equal event weights (section~\ref{sec:unfolding}); its effect on the result was not tested.
